claim: Schloss Schauenstein offers 12 rooms/suites across three buildings (Castle, Seidenhaus, Meierhaus) with rates CHF 610–1,070+ per night including breakfast.
quote: Suite Feuer ... CHF 840/Nacht (inkl. Frühstück) ... Zimmer Linde ... CHF 610/Nacht ... Suite Luft ... CHF 1'070/Nacht

claim: Schloss Schauenstein is alpine fine-dining with three Michelin stars combined with a boutique hotel.
quote: Alpines Fine-Dining mit drei Michelin-Sternen und Boutiquehotel

claim: Guests can extend the Schauenstein dining experience by sleeping in the castle or the neighbouring Meierhaus.
quote: historic rooms and suites in the castle or in the neighboring Meierhaus

claim: Schloss Schauenstein is a member of The Living Circle, a curated group of first-class hotels and restaurants.
quote: a hand-picked group of first-class hotels and restaurants in incomparably beautiful locations, run by dedicated hosts

claim: Casa Caminada offers 10 rooms across four categories at CHF 260–380 per night including breakfast.
quote: Standard CHF 260 ... Standard Plus CHF 290 ... Deluxe CHF 340 ... Deluxe Plus CHF 380 ... ten rooms

claim: Casa Caminada is a Michelin Guide hotel: a 300-year-old barn-and-stable transformed by designer Patricia Urquiola; restaurant carries a Michelin Green Star; the next-door Schauenstein restaurant has three Michelin stars.
quote: 300-year-old barn and stable has been thoroughly transformed into a stylish, contemporary boutique hotel, designed by the Spanish hospitality expert Patricia Urquiola ... own restaurant has a MICHELIN Green Star ... within its parent hotel Schloss Schauenstein, where chef Andreas Caminada's kitchen has earned three MICHELIN Stars

claim: Casa Caminada is roughly a 5-minute walk from Schloss Schauenstein.
quote: Casa Caminada Hotel includes 10 rooms and is nearly a 5-minute walk from Schloss Schauenstein

claim: Casa Caminada opened in 2018 in the castle's former stables, designed by Patricia Urquiola; rooms feature warm wood, linens and private balconies.
quote: set in the castle's former stables ... designed by Spanish-born interiors guru Patricia Urquiola ... warm woods, simple furnishings, and crisp Italian linens ... private balcony

claim: Schauenstein Schloss Hotel Restaurant has a 4.8/5 TripAdvisor rating across 93 reviews and ranks #1 of 1 lodge in Fürstenau; dining and rooms are integrated on-site.
quote: 4.8 out of 5 rating across 93 reviews ... #1 of 1 lodge in Fuerstenau ... diners mentioning being 'taken back upstairs' after meals

claim: Gasthaus Waldheim is in Fürstenaubruck, around 0.5 mi from Schloss Schauenstein, with rooms from about $119/night.
quote: Schloss Schauenstein ... only 0.5 miles from Gasthaus Waldheim ... SEASON DEALS FROM $119

claim: Gasthaus Waldheim has six simply furnished rooms with TV and washbasin; showers and toilets are shared in the corridor; closed Wednesdays.
quote: the property provides 6 rooms ... simply furnished, with each room equipped with a TV set and a washbasin ... shared shower and toilet is located on the corridor ... closed on Wednesdays

claim: Gasthaus Waldheim averages 8.1/10 across ~220 Booking.com reviews; renowned restaurant of regional Domleschg specialities; free WiFi and parking; some rooms face a noisy main road.
quote: average rating of 8.1 out of 10 stars in 226 reviews ... renowned restaurant serving specialties from the Domleschg Region ... advise requesting a room away from the main road

claim: TripAdvisor lists only two B&Bs in Fürstenau proper — Casa Caminada and Gasthaus Waldheim — and the closest options beyond are Landhus Almens (1.3 mi) and Hotel Reich (0.82 mi).
quote: only 2 properties match filters directly within Fürstenau itself ... Landhus Almens ... 1.3 miles from Fürstenau center ... Hotel Reich ... 0.82 miles from Fürstenau center

claim: Sils im Domleschg, the village across the Rhine from Fürstenau, lists only two lodgings: Gasthaus Post and Jugendherberge Sils (youth hostel).
Gasthaus Post in Sils im Domleschg offers double, single and family rooms with private bath, regional breakfast buffet, contemporary décor, and is ranked #1 restaurant in the village.
quote: double rooms with their own bathroom with toilet and shower ... family room ... rooms are comfortable with restrained and contemporary décor ... regional breakfast buffet ... #1 among Sils im Domleschg restaurants

claim: Landhus Almens (in adjacent Almens) is a small 5–6 room family-run inn with a praised restaurant focused on local producers.
quote: This is a very small hotel - only 5-6 rooms ... The food served in the restaurant is exceptional ... The owner knows the local producers by name

claim: Schauenstein takes reservations for hotel and restaurant up to eight months in advance.
quote: Schloss Schauenstein accepts reservations for the hotel and restaurant up to 8 months in advance

claim: Casa Caminada rooms are a minimalist-chic alpine lodge with heavy timbers against modern furnishings; some rooms have a balcony and sitting area.
quote: minimalist-chic interpretation of the typical Alpine lodge, their heavy timbers set against modern furnishings ... Certain rooms have a balcony and a sitting area
